research.job_description_summary: Cisco hires new-graduate software engineers in India (mainly Bengaluru). An August 2026 FACE Prep guide, citing 2025-cycle candidate accounts for the assessment format, describes eligibility shortlisting, a 90-minute online assessment (about 40 MCQs and 2 DSA problems), one or two technical interviews and a managerial and HR round. September 2026 Glassdoor reviews describe a recruiter screen, a HackerRank assessment with 2 DSA problems and MCQs on networking, OS and CS fundamentals, a technical screen with live coding, a virtual loop with DSA, design and a managerial round, and HR. The official careers pages were not fetched.
required_skills: Computer networks (OSI, TCP/IP, subnetting, DNS, routing)
limitations: Cisco's official careers pages were not fetched, so no round is marked DOCUMENTED.

The FACE Prep guide (2026-08-14) ties only the assessment format and coding difficulty to candidate accounts; its interview topics and managerial questions are the author's expectations, so they are class D.

Glassdoor reviews dated September 2026 give round structures and two specific questions ('why did you decide to use this particular data set for this project' and 'explain the code about something technical'); an October 2024 review (three coding questions in 90 minutes) is older than the 2025 cutoff and used as context only.
The guide's package figures (about 18 to 20 LPA) come from third-party aggregation and were not used.
Software versus networking role splits are described in the guide; this bank is for the software role with networking fundamentals kept because the assessment includes them.
Reported items carry one report each and are unverified.

Evidence handling: practice questions cite no sources; where a source only supplied topic context it is named in the question notes. Practice and job-description-inferred questions are UNVERIFIED and capped at LOW confidence on import.

Review status: answers, samples and cited counts come from the researcher and were not independently re-run; spot checks only. Source titles and some dates are blank because the sources did not show them.
Source pages on LeetCode Discuss and Glassdoor returned HTTP 403 to the CodeArena audit tool (2026-10-11), so the cited questions were not re-confirmed against those pages.
